seeded_defects._comment: 채점기 전용 — 후보에게 비공개. legacy_app에 의도적으로 심은 결함과 검증 방법.

D2-kpi-after-limit.where: KPIs computed from LIMIT 1000 sample in pandas
D2-kpi-after-limit.verify: KPI vs ground-truth SQL over full filter

D3-hardcoded-http-path.verify: static scan + boots with only DATABRICKS_WAREHOUSE_ID set

D5-silent-except.verify: simulated query failure → visible st.error + retry, not silent empty dashboard

D6-date-off-by-one.where: '<= end_date' string compare drops the end day after 00:00
D6-date-off-by-one.verify: window row count vs half-open ground truth

D8-no-caching.where: full re-query on every rerun, new connection per query
D8-no-caching.verify: query history: filter change ≤ 3 queries, unchanged rerun 0

repair_scoring: repair 점수 = 수정 확인된 결함 수 / 8 (부분점수 없음, 결함별 pass/fail)

extend_test_cases.operation: Apply a known window; inspect dropoff_chart.
extend_test_cases.expected: Top-10 dropoff_zip matches ground truth (NULL 제외, tie는 zip ASC).

extend_test_cases.operation: Download CSV under the same window.
extend_test_cases.expected: Columns/ordering match the table's ground-truth query, cap 10000.

robustness_scenarios.expected: App renders with error state + retry button; no crash loop.

robustness_scenarios.inject: grader proxy delays SQL responses beyond client timeout mid-session
robustness_scenarios.expected: st.error + retry; process alive; recovers when backend restored.

robustness_scenarios.inject: Playwright fuzzer: 5 min random clicks/keystrokes/date combos (fixed seed)
robustness_scenarios.expected: 0 unhandled exceptions; crash count reported as metric.
